incidents.title: Checkout latency after payments v2.3 deploy

timeline.event: Engineer correlates the alert with payments-service v2.3
Payments rolled back to v2.2; checkout restarted

incidents.root_cause: Unbounded Redis connections in payments-service exhausted capacity used by checkout-service.
contributing_factors: Traffic overlapped the 02:00 UTC nightly settlement batch.
incidents.mitigation: Rolled back payments-service to v2.2 and restarted checkout-service to drain connections.

permanent_fix.desc: Add a bounded pool and connection timeout.

retain.content: INCIDENT INC-1047 (RESOLVED). checkout-service p99 reached 3.2s and 5xx reached 12% at 02:14 UTC. payments-service v2.3, deployed at 01:58, opened unbounded Redis connections while the nightly settlement batch was active. ROOT CAUSE: Redis connection capacity exhaustion caused by payments-service. MITIGATION THAT WORKED: roll back payments to v2.2 and restart checkout-service. MTTR: 90 minutes. PERMANENT FIX: JIRA-891, bounded pool and connection timeout, remains open.
retain.context: SRE production incident postmortem. Environment: prod. Severity: SEV-2.

incidents.title: Orders writes blocked by schema migration

timeline.event: Database activity showed an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock

incidents.root_cause: A long-running ALTER TABLE migration held an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on the orders table.
contributing_factors: The migration was scheduled during business traffic.
incidents.mitigation: Terminated the migration and rescheduled it for the maintenance window.

permanent_fix.desc: Require lock-timeout and off-peak scheduling for DDL.

retain.content: INCIDENT INC-1052 (RESOLVED). orders-service writes timed out at 15:22 UTC. ROOT CAUSE: a long-running ALTER TABLE migration held an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE Postgres lock. MITIGATION THAT WORKED: terminate the migration and reschedule it off-peak. MTTR: 75 minutes. This incident was unrelated to Redis or payments deployments.
retain.context: SRE production incident postmortem. Environment: prod. Severity: SEV-2.

incidents.title: Checkout reads delayed by replica lag

timeline.event: No recent deploy or Redis saturation found
Replica lag traced to a failed vacuum and write burst
Reads shifted to a healthy replica

incidents.root_cause: A failed vacuum followed by a write burst caused checkout's Postgres read replica to lag.
contributing_factors: Replica-lag alert threshold was too high.
incidents.mitigation: Shifted checkout reads to a healthy replica and restarted vacuum on the lagging node.

permanent_fix.desc: Lower replica-lag alert threshold and repair vacuum monitoring.

retain.content: INCIDENT INC-1061 (RESOLVED). checkout-service p99 reached 2.8s at 15:07 UTC with stale reads. There was no recent deploy and Redis was healthy. ROOT CAUSE: checkout Postgres read-replica lag after a failed vacuum and write burst. MITIGATION THAT WORKED: shift reads to a healthy replica and restart vacuum. MTTR: 40 minutes.
retain.context: SRE production incident postmortem. Environment: prod. Severity: SEV-2.

incidents.title: Catalog latency caused by cache stampede
incidents.root_cause: A bulk cache expiry caused a request stampede against catalog storage.
contributing_factors: Cache keys used the same TTL without jitter.
incidents.mitigation: Warmed popular keys and rate-limited origin requests.

permanent_fix.desc: Add TTL jitter and request coalescing.

retain.content: INCIDENT INC-1038 (RESOLVED). catalog-service slowed after bulk cache expiry. ROOT CAUSE: cache stampede. MITIGATION: warm popular keys and rate-limit origin traffic. MTTR: 32 minutes.
retain.context: SRE production incident postmortem. Environment: prod. Severity: SEV-3.

incidents.title: Payments errors caused by certificate expiry
incidents.root_cause: The payment processor client certificate expired.
contributing_factors: Certificate-expiry alert was routed to an inactive channel.
incidents.mitigation: Rotated the client certificate and recycled payment workers.

retain.content: INCIDENT INC-1068 (RESOLVED). payments-service returned 31% 5xx due to TLS failures. ROOT CAUSE: an expired processor client certificate. MITIGATION: rotate the certificate and recycle workers. MTTR: 21 minutes.
retain.context: SRE production incident postmortem. Environment: prod. Severity: SEV-1.

world_facts.content: Northwind Pay's nightly settlement batch starts at 02:00 UTC and increases load on the Redis cluster shared by checkout-service and payments-service.
JIRA-891 tracks bounded Redis connection pools and acquisition timeouts for payments-service; it was still open on 2026-09-29.
